title: Wall Street points to more losses as oil, bond yields rise and odds of a Fed rate hike increase
description: Wall Street futures are sliding but are off earlier lows with the opening bell approaching. Artificial-intelligence stocks slid overnight and oil prices continued to climb as fighting in the Middle East keeps squeezing the global flow of crude amid rising doubts that the United States and Iran can come to a resolution in their conflict any time soon. Futures for the S&P 500 fell 0.2%, while Dow Jones Industrial Average futures fell 0.3%. Nasdaq futures were ticked down just 0.1%. Benchmark U.S. crude rose $1.03 to $103.61 a barrel early Tuesday. Brent crude, the international standard, gained 0.3% to $106.94 a barrel.
content:

title: As AI debate flares, Melania Trump will tour a North Carolina school to see technology at work
description: First lady Melania Trump is set to visit northwestern North Carolina to talk to elementary school students, teachers and staff about how they’re using technology in the classroom. Her long-planned trip Tuesday comes as tech and political leaders fight about how best to regulate artificial intelligence. Prominent tech leaders have said they're worried about the dangers of AI and called for more oversight. But President Donald Trump has dismissed that idea, calling it a “hoax.” A year ago, the first lady sounded a note of caution, saying the technology was at a “primitive stage” and needed “watchful guidance.”
